golgotha_cross: three rough-hewn crosses raised on a bare rock hill outside the city, dust lifting off stone in hot wind, harsh midday light collapsing toward a bruised, storm-dark sky
sparrow_field: a teacher standing among bending grain stalks at golden hour, small birds rising and settling across tilled earth, warm low sun flooding the field, a worn path running between furrows
rich_mans_table: a lavishly set table crowded with food and wine under an awning, fine embroidered robes on a reclining figure, warm lamplight and gold vessels
beggars_gate: a carved stone gatepost outside a wealthy house, a thin sore-covered figure slumped against it, dogs nearby in the dust
chasm_fire: a deep rock ravine at the edge of two afterlife states, one side warm and golden, the other glowing red-orange with heat haze, jagged rock on both rims
fathers_house: a house of many rooms lit warm from within, doorways receding down a long hall toward daylight, worn stone thresholds and fresh linen
bethany_tomb: a stone tomb sealed into a dry Judean hillside, a heavy rolling stone across the entrance, rope and dry palm fronds, weathered stone worn smooth
wedding_hall_empty: an empty banquet hall with unlit oil lamps and folded linens stacked on a long table, dust suspended in still afternoon light through a high window
angels_light: tall figures of radiant but softly-glowing light standing at the edge of a bright threshold, warm gold light pooling where they stand
narrow_gate: a narrow gate set into a weathered mud-brick wall at a hillside's edge, rough stone and packed dirt, late golden light in the gap
wide_road_crowd: a broad well-worn road crowded with travelers moving downhill under open sky, dust rising under many feet, loose groups stretching toward the horizon
orchard_trees: a hillside orchard of fruit trees in full leaf, dappled sunlight through branches, some limbs heavy with fruit and others bare and cut back
judgment_throne: a raised throne on wide stone steps facing a vast open plain, multitudes gathered below in the last light of day, deep shadow pooling at the base of the steps
sheep_goats: two flocks separating on an open hillside, sheep moving to one side and goats to the other, a shepherd figure standing at the point of division
barns_bursting: wooden granaries and storage barns under a night sky thick with stars, torchlight moving between them, sacks of grain stacked high against the walls
night_stars_soul: a solitary figure beneath a vast star-filled night sky, a torch guttering out nearby, cold clear air and open ground stretching into darkness
gate_of_glory: an immense gate standing open at the crest of a hill, full-width brilliant light pouring through it onto the landscape below, the wide road and the narrow gate both visible far beneath
